params.name: wB
params.let: 'belongs to' if f1 == 1 else 'does not belong to'

params.name: wC
params.let: 'belongs to' if f2 == 1 else 'does not belong to'

params.name: wD
params.let: 'belongs to' if f3 == 1 else 'does not belong to'

stem: If $X = [{=a}, {=b}]$, how many of the points $A({=a}, {=b})$, $B({=b}, {=yB})$, $C({=xC}, {=a + 1})$ and $D({=b - 1}, {=yD})$ belong to the cartesian product $X \times X$?
solution: A point belongs to $X \times X$ only if both of its coordinates are in $X = [{=a}, {=b}]$.
$A({=a}, {=b})$: both {=a} and {=b} are in $X$, so A belongs to $X \times X$.
$B({=b}, {=yB})$: {=b} is in $X$ and {=yB} is {=('in' if f1 == 1 else 'not in')} $X$, so B {=wB} $X \times X$.
$C({=xC}, {=a + 1})$: {=a + 1} is in $X$ and {=xC} is {=('in' if f2 == 1 else 'not in')} $X$, so C {=wC} $X \times X$.
$D({=b - 1}, {=yD})$: {=b - 1} is in $X$ and {=yD} is {=('in' if f3 == 1 else 'not in')} $X$, so D {=wD} $X \times X$.
The number of points that belong to $X \times X$ is {=1 + f1 + f2 + f3}.
notes: Advanced: four points, interval endpoints included (closed), count of members. A always in (corner point); b-1 and a+1 always in X since a<=-2, b>=2. Out values b+1, a-1, a-2 are clearly below a / above b.
